options.online: Yes, and I want to get paid online

reasons.online: Getting paid online needs a real store: cart, orders and sales tracking. I add the monthly support, because a store without visitors sells nothing.
reasons.many: With more than twenty products, your catalogue is your best argument. It needs to live on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and in Google.
reasons.working: Your site holds up — no need to rebuild it. What you're missing is consistency: being found and posting every week.
reasons.outdated: An outdated site does more harm than no site at all. We start again with a credible storefront and your catalogue.
reasons.starting: You're starting from nothing: what matters is existing on Google Maps and getting your first WhatsApp enquiries. We'll think bigger later.

items.payment: 60% on order and 40% before going live.
items.exclusions: Advertising, domain name, APIs and third-party subscriptions are not included.
items.extras: Additional products, pages and automations are billed separately.
items.seoCommitment: Monthly search work: six-month commitment recommended.
items.humanReview: Nothing is published without your approval, including anything prepared automatically.
items.maintenance: Maintenance covers fixes and monitoring, not new features.
items.ownership: Your domain name and all your accounts are created in your name and belong to you.

items.q: It's too expensive for my business.
items.a: What is a new customer worth to you? If it's 15,000 FCFA, the Visible Business pack pays for itself after 33 customers. The real question isn't the amount, it's how fast it comes back to you.

items.q: My nephew can build me a site for less.
items.a: He can, yes. What he won't do is your Google listing, your WhatsApp catalogue, the measurement of what it earns you, and twelve posts a month for a year. A site is an object; what I sell you is a system.

items.q: How many customers do you guarantee me?
items.a: None — and be wary of anyone who guarantees you a number. I guarantee the quality of what I install and the consistency of what I publish. How many customers that brings also depends on your offer and your prices, which I don't control.

items.q: If I stop, do I lose everything?
items.a: No. Your domain name, your content and your Google, Facebook and WhatsApp accounts are created in your name from day one. They stay yours, whatever happens.
One to three weeks depending on the pack, counting from when I've received your logo, your photos and your product list. The timeline mostly depends on how quickly you send them to me.
Yes, and I'd recommend it. Local Presence is enough to exist on Google Maps and get your first enquiries. We move up a level when your numbers justify it, not before.
